# AI Agent Snapshot CQRS Gate

Executable SSOT: [`ai-agent-snapshot-cqrs-gate.riido.json`](ai-agent-snapshot-cqrs-gate.riido.json).

## Decision

Do not promote the whole control-plane Store to CQS/CQRS yet.

Scope: `ai_agent_client_snapshot_only`.

Current trace evidence identifies AI Agent client snapshot load/save as the CQRS candidate, not the whole Store.

## Evidence Shape

- `/v1/daemon/runtime-snapshot` (`command_sync`)
  - `ai_agent_client_snapshot_load`
  - `ai_agent_client_snapshot_save`
- `/v1/daemon/agent-bindings` (`query_bindings`)
  - `ai_agent_client_snapshot_load`
- `/v1/agents/{agent_id}/poll` (`poll_assignment`)
  - `store_poll_assignment`

## Measurement Gate

### Signals

- `ai_agent_client_snapshot_load_calls_total`
- `ai_agent_client_snapshot_save_calls_total`
- `ai_agent_client_snapshot_load_bytes_last`
- `ai_agent_client_snapshot_save_bytes_last`
- `DynamoDB ConsumedReadCapacityUnits`
- `DynamoDB ConsumedWriteCapacityUnits`
- `X-Ray route/store-operation samples`

## Decision Rules

- `keep_monolithic_snapshot`: if request units drop by at least threshold and snapshot operations no longer dominate sampled Store traces, `keep_monolithic_snapshot` with threshold `50%`.
- `split_ai_agent_client_snapshot`: if request units drop by less than threshold or snapshot operations remain dominant, `split_ai_agent_client_snapshot_only` with threshold `50%`.

## Candidate Split

### Command Models

- `daemon runtime snapshot sync`
- `daemon heartbeat/status save`
- `device credential and daemon command mutations`
- `cold recovery checkpoint`

### Query Models

- `agent bindings read model`
- `runtime/device status read model`
- `task-thread participant/progress projection`

## Evidence Loop

| Step | Statement |
| --- | --- |
| Observe | Development traces showed snapshot load/save operations on runtime-snapshot and agent-bindings paths, while broader Store CQRS had no matching evidence. |
| Hypothesis | A narrow snapshot CQRS gate can keep optimization scoped to the observed hot item until post-cadence measurements prove a split is needed. |
| Execute | Record route-to-store-operation evidence, cadence rules, measurement signals, decision thresholds, and forbidden trace attributes in this manifest. |
| Evaluate | The snapshot CQRS verifier checks operations, signals, decision rules, and forbidden public trace attributes before the reader can be trusted. |
| Retrospective | This keeps cost optimization evidence-driven: cadence changes are measured first, and only the AI Agent snapshot becomes a CQRS candidate. |
